  - The Savannah African Art Museum - Houses a collection of African art and artifacts.
  - The Georgia State Railroad Museum - Features steam locomotives and interactive exhibits.
  - The Savannah Bee Company - Offers honey tastings, beekeeping classes, and honey-based products.
